preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10^5.
Length of the first string row1 is between 1 and 10^5.
Length of the second string col1 is between 1 and 10^5.
Number of queries Q is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all('0' <= c <= '1' for c in row1)
preconditions.description: All characters in row1 are either '0' or '1'.

preconditions.expression: all('0' <= c <= '1' for c in col1)
preconditions.description: All characters in col1 are either '0' or '1'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= len(col1) for x, y in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, x is between 1 and the length of col1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= y <= len(row1) for x, y in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, y is between 1 and the length of row1.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(result) == Q for result in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line has a length equal to the number of queries Q.

postconditions.expression: all('0' <= c <= '1' for result in output for c in result)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output are either '0' or '1'.
